events.title: Soup Kitchen Meal Service
events.description: Our Soup Kitchen Meal Service provides a hot meal every weekday from 10:30 am to 12:30 pm. Each meal is designed with health in mind and is made up of the recommended balance of fruit, vegetables, grains, protein and dairy.

events.title: Fall Adult Education: Episcopalians 101
events.description:
What makes the Episcopal Church unique? What creates the rhythm of our worship? How do we make decisions? For an opportunity to discuss these questions and more, please join us for a five week Christian Education series on “Episcopalians 101.” We will convene on the second floor of the Mission House at 10 am on October 4, 11, 18, 25, and November 1. All are welcome to join the conversation!

October 4: Who We Are? (History), led by Mother Susan
October 11: What Do We Believe? (Catechism), led by Mother Anna
October 18: How Do We Worship? (BCP), led by Mother Susan
October 25: How Do We Make Decisions? (Polity), led by Mother Susan
November 1: How Do We Share the Good News? (Q & A), led by Mother Anna
No Class Scheduled November 8 – November 29

events.title: The Twenty-First Sunday after Pentecost — Holy Eucharist (with Music)
events.description:
We will gather in person for the celebration of the Holy Eucharist at 11 am. The live-stream of the service at this link: https://3852-Church-of-the-Holy-Apostles.livecontrol.tv/b39e8f71 — if you have tech troubles, contact LiveControl by clicking the “Support Chat” button at the bottom of the web player and you will be able to connect with a LiveControl support technician via text. Hospitality & Fellowship and Sunday Supper Follow.

All are welcome as we gather in person together in our beloved church.
Holy Eucharist (with Music)
Lesson: Isaiah 45:1-7
Psalm: 96:1-9, (10-13)
Epistle: 1 Thessalonians 1:1-10
Gospel: Matthew 22:15-22
Hospitality & Fellowship  — Then Sunday Supper Follows
